Definition: Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person
BiblicalUsage: Two men share this name, and Scripture keeps them apart. One Ithiel is a Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the return from exile, and the other is the man to whom Agur speaks the words of Proverbs 30 — the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name reminds me that God knows His people by name, whether they are listed among the returned exiles or named once as the hearer of a proverb.
